items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He was a saxophone player with Erskine Hawkins. He was drumming with this show. And he got me on the show, in the band...

ctx.x: [SINGS] That was one of Erskine Hawkins' big hits. What was his name? Smitty... Always called him Smitty. He was a drummer. He was not a saxophone player at that time, when he was with the show.
Did he play the drums with Erskine Hawkins later on?
